name: unifi_location_timeline
title: UniFi Incident Evidence
description: Collect validated, bounded incident evidence from Network and Protect across relay locations. Returns a unifi-incident-evidence-view by default (source outcomes, coverage and explicit location failures plus record citations fitted to one tool result, resumable from record_selection.next_cursor); detail=full returns the whole combined document. A call reads at most 7 sources (locations × products, one Protect source per camera). Check coverage_complete before treating an empty set as clear. Access collection is unsupported.

start.description: Inclusive window start, ISO 8601 with UTC offset

end.description: Exclusive window end, ISO 8601 with UTC offset

location_id.description: The location's UUID (location_id from the location list, not its name) to filter to one location; omit to query all connected locations, at most 7 sources in all

products.description: Products to collect: network, protect, access (Access is explicitly unsupported)

detail.description: view: coverage plus bounded record citations; full: the whole combined evidence document

max_records_returned.description: Most record citations in the view (default 25); omitted records stay in coverage. View only

resume_after.description: record_selection.next_cursor from an earlier view of the same request; returns the records after it. View only
